title: Laulau Day.
bodyText: The first Friday in May of each year shall be known and designated as "Laulau Day". This day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday.
bodyHtml: [§8-42]  Laulau Day.  The first Friday in May of each year shall be known and designated as "Laulau Day".  This day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday. [L 2025, c 270, §2]
